# ProClear Solutions AZ

> ProClear Solutions is a locally-owned Arizona property preservation company specializing in foreclosure cleanouts, trash-outs, and property turnover services. We serve REO companies, asset managers, landlords, and government agencies statewide with 24-48 hour response times. Bonded, insured, and GSE compliant. Based in Tucson, AZ.

## Services

- **Foreclosure Cleanouts** — Complete debris and personal property removal, leaving units broom-clean and market-ready
- **Trash-Out Services** — Full junk removal with responsible donation and recycling practices
- **Yard & Landscape Maintenance** — Mowing, trimming, weed abatement, and desert landscaping cleanup
- **Lock Changes & Securing** — Deadbolt installation, re-keying, padlocks, and full property securing
- **Handyman & Repairs** — Minor plumbing, electrical, drywall patches, fixture replacements, and general maintenance
- **Property Inspections** — Photo-documented condition reports for asset managers, banks, and investors
- **Paint & Touch-Ups** — Interior and exterior painting, cosmetic repairs, and turnover prep
- **Winterization & De-Winterization** — Plumbing system protection during vacancy periods

## Service Area

- **Headquarters:** Tucson, Arizona (same-day service available)
- **Statewide coverage:** Phoenix metro, East Valley (Mesa, Chandler, Gilbert, Tempe), West Valley (Glendale, Peoria, Surprise), Cochise County, and Northern Arizona
- **Available throughout:** All of Arizona

## Why Choose ProClear Solutions

- Bonded and fully insured with comprehensive liability coverage
- 24-48 hour response and turnaround times
- 5-star rated service
- GSE compliant (Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, HUD standards)
- Photo-documented work verification on every job
- Eco-friendly disposal with donation and recycling focus
- Transparent, upfront pricing with no hidden fees
- Locally owned and operated in Arizona

## Ideal Clients

- REO (Real Estate Owned) companies and servicers
- Asset management companies
- Property management firms
- Banks and financial institutions
- Landlords and private investors
- Government agencies (HUD, VA, municipal)
- Real estate agents handling distressed properties
